title: G8 per-span outcomes
description: Per-span outcome aggregate derived by resecta_data.eval.spans from one G8 emitter's JSON-Lines sidecar (one row per ground-truth span of all 17 families plus one row per surfaced detection overlapping no ground-truth span; offsets only, never text) joined to the G8 corpus. Counts per family x doctype x bucket x outcome with a Wilson interval on recall; when the corpus carries the context annotation (every span's context_class), the ground-truth rows again per family x context class and per family x doctype x bucket x context class; when the corpus carries planted furniture (a generator profile's furniture[] regions), the detection-only fp rows per family x furniture kind. Dev/eval artifact: not installed to the Swift Resources path.

schema_version.description: Wire-format version. 2 since the context-class tables (by_context_class, cells_by_context_class) and the context_class descriptor; 3 since the furniture join (by_furniture_kind and the furniture descriptor) over the detection-only rows.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

site.description: The emitter site the sidecar came from, as the trio's _cells.json names it (detector or siteB); unknown when no cells payload accompanied the sidecar.

source_spans_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the sidecar bytes (a hash of the input, not a wall-clock).

source_corpus_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the corpus bytes the rows were joined to.

join_rule.description: The overlap rule under which the emitter assigned outcomes (binary half-open offset overlap, same family).

context_class.description: Null when the joined corpus carries no context annotation; otherwise where the class was read from (the corpus span, never the emitter), the full vocabulary and the classes present. The class tables below are empty in the null case.

furniture.description: Null when no document of the joined corpus carries planted furniture (the corpus as furnished); otherwise where the regions were read from (the corpus document, never the emitter), the join rule, the kinds present and the region count. by_furniture_kind is empty in the null case.

ground_truth.description: Rows that name a corpus span (tp, fn, tn, fired must_not); equals corpus_spans by construction.

fp.description: Detection-only rows (tier null): surfaced detections overlapping no ground-truth span of their family.

tn.description: Planted must_not spans that stayed quiet.

must_not_fired.description: Planted must_not spans that fired (fp rows carrying tier must_not).

one_token_rule.description: How one_token_tp is counted (from offsets and the corpus text on this side).

status.description: identical when the sidecar reproduced every counter of the trio's _cells.json it was reconciled against; not_run when no cells payload was supplied. A mismatch is an error, never an artifact.

per_family.description: One tally per corpus family (the corpus vocabulary: ssn, npi, dea, dob, address, account, mrn, name, phone, email, routingNumber, ein, itin, creditCard, driversLicense, passport, licensePlate).

cells.description: One tally per family_doctype_bucket cell, with the cell's coordinates repeated inside; context_class is null here because these cells are class-agnostic (see cells_by_context_class).

by_context_class.description: Ground-truth rows per corpus family, then per context class (the corpus span's annotation): tp / fn / tn / fired must_not; fp is 0 by construction (a detection-only row names no span). Empty on an unannotated corpus.

cells_by_context_class.description: One tally per family_doctype_bucket_class cell over the ground-truth rows, with the coordinates and the class repeated inside. Empty on an unannotated corpus.

by_furniture_kind.description: Detection-only fp rows (tier null) per corpus family, then per furniture kind the detection overlaps (role_noun, label, plate_label, salutation, closing from the Spec-D generator; a row overlapping no region counts under 'unattributed'; a row overlapping two kinds counts once under each). Each kind carries the count and its split by doctype. Empty when the corpus carries no furniture.

one_token_tp.description: tp rows whose detection overlaps fewer whitespace-separated tokens than the ground-truth span holds.

recall.description: tp / (tp + fn); 0.0 when the denominator is zero.

recall_wilson95.description: Wilson 95% interval on recall_all_tokens; null when tp + fn is zero.

recall_all_tokens.description: (tp - one_token_tp) / (tp + fn): recall credited only when every token of the ground-truth span is covered by a detection; 0.0 when the denominator is zero.

recall_all_tokens_wilson95.description: Wilson 95% interval on recall; null when tp + fn is zero.

token_coverage.description: Histogram of tp rows keyed 'covered/total' whitespace-separated tokens (the detections' joint token reach over the ground-truth span).

detections_per_tp.description: Histogram of tp rows keyed by how many surfaced detections overlapped the ground-truth span (the name path emits one per token).
